## Design

### 2026-10-17 – So I started working on one part of my marble course it took me a few tries though to build things because I just started and I had to build a couple of planes. I built one plane for my composite curv

**3.5h**

So I started working on one part of my marble course it took me a few tries though to build things because I just started and I had to build a couple of planes. I built one plane for my composite curve of the course sketch, and one plane for the like shape of the course (the 3d version) I had to experiment around and  change the placing of my course because at first the angle was too big (I used 70 degrees) but then after the sketch I realized it wouldnt work so I researched how to change the degrees of the plane again and experimented with different angles until I found one I was satisfied with. Then I created like the marble course itself (the 3d part) and realised I was drawing on the wrong plane so I made myself a new plane and redrew it. Next I plan on adding more courses but I feel like I have limited space... and I also forgot to mention I added like the box where the marble drops into.

### 2026-10-18 – At first I started working on a second course (around 2 hours) as shown below:

**6h**

At first I started working on a second course (around 2 hours) as shown below:

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 000928](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xuHXGjbfIPz0CnJ1Vq2xr27VriNQEoOI/ae555ad6ae54c901d6d3df8cf306a63449de06a04fa61814071f881ad808dd94.jpg)

After many attempts (like a good hour and a half), this part was supposed to be a second course but I figured that connecting both this course and the first course I began working on (shown below) would be better.

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 125332](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xuHXGjbfIPz0CnJ1Vq2xr27VriNQEoOI/db5a8870de4a41263fcf40f373796627e69bf34d261a889d3882203819aed74e.jpg)

So I started working on connecting them together then I came across a problem, I couldn't find a way to connect the top course (the second course originally) with my bottom course (the first course originally) I tried creating planes but for some reason I couldnt create the exact plane I wanted to no matter how hard I tried. So I decided on creating something that would just directly drop the marble down to the next course as shown below:

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 000950](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xuHXGjbfIPz0CnJ1Vq2xr27VriNQEoOI/e8488ac54b20fcd7104e920270cf9148234acce470082a5a4db088eb5355685c.jpg)

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 000912](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xuHXGjbfIPz0CnJ1Vq2xr27VriNQEoOI/ec837b014afc6858f1e1f9ed9ace49cb9d027d18d2a014ff8ae8eaa914afff74.jpg)

This part took me around 2 hours because I had to experiment a LOT with this until I figured out something I was satisfied with. Then I the final piece for now looks like this:

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 001217](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xuHXGjbfIPz0CnJ1Vq2xr27VriNQEoOI/8baed9aa2125c39ccd869141524464843341dc3e26b701141ebba8cddb653d62.jpg)

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 001156](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xuHXGjbfIPz0CnJ1Vq2xr27VriNQEoOI/ff8ba998ae7bd4d64d2fdd292abcf676ac9394284cc60b399f07cfcaf20d0be9.jpg)

For my next session, I want to work on making it so when the marble goes through that drop it won't go off course so I want to maybe add some borders to the bottom track a bit more so it'll stay inside the track. This may seem like a lot done in a day but I had to lock in because I knew I only had like a day left so I'm hoping to finish early tomorrow morning in around ~4-5 hours because I might have to manually add supports.

### 2026-10-18 – I started working on extending the course and I came upon a couple of issues; one of main reoccuring issues is creating the exact plane that I want for some reason I get problems when using the line a

**3h**

I started working on extending the course and I came upon a couple of issues; one of main reoccuring issues is creating the exact plane that I want for some reason I get problems when using the line angle plane type because every time I click right plane it says it doesnt work so I have to use the mid line plane which is a bit hard but it works so I started drawing my track and after sweeping, I realised I made it too long:

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 141246](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xuHXGjbfIPz0CnJ1Vq2xr27VriNQEoOI/42826658fd5ebfb1f1cb44c72a44acb24a37474bdcd8a851e79f04b79fb421fa.jpg)

As you can see its way past the base, so I spent a good hour trying to fix it because every time I tried fixing that sketch layer, the parts wouldnt  be aligned for some reason? So I had to redo my sketch sadly and came up with this:

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 143548](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xuHXGjbfIPz0CnJ1Vq2xr27VriNQEoOI/9a2473a98ef9f74e29f8ea1482fc981e00c211d4278d1aaf1e51cf1dd51e3357.jpg)

Then by creating the shape for the thickness of the course using a mid line plane again, I sweeped the whole thing and ended up with this:

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 141919](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xuHXGjbfIPz0CnJ1Vq2xr27VriNQEoOI/29a24171e8deec6b9c475056618386a6f6d39991ac8700acb8f85e0d119d17fa.jpg)

I also used the thickness feature which is very handy, to shape it better.
